title: Creative Idea / Your Way, Way Better
slide_intent: Connect the creative idea to a perception problem so execution addresses what audiences need to reconsider.
strategic_value: The food-improvement story can help Burger King frame its visual change as meaningful rather than cosmetic.
demonstration: A large creative phrase is followed by two paragraphs contrasting fast-food perceptions with the brand’s stated food changes.
practical_value: Explain which perception a design change is intended to shift, without claiming that shift has been measured.

content_islands.name: Creative phrase
content_islands.spec: Place Your Way, Way Better at the top of the right column.

content_islands.name: Perception gap
content_islands.spec: Set the rationale below, followed by the source’s food-improvement claims.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly frames design as a way to close a gap between negative perceptions and its food story.
